page_title: GEN 2-1 LEC | Genoa v Lecce 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
90+5' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+4' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Vogliacco departs the field of play to be replaced by Alan Matturro (Genoa).
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Genoa.
90+1' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) replacing Antonino Gallo.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mohamed Kaba will be replaced by Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
90' Mateo Retegui goes off the pitch and Emil Bohinen (Genoa) comes on.
89' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Josep Martinez.
89' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

89' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
86' The free kick is taken by Hamza Rafia (Lecce), but ball is cleared.
86' Referee Luca Pairetto sees the trip by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Lecce have been awarded a free kick.
85' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but Josep Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
82' Lameck Banda (Lecce) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
80' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
78' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 18:15.
76' 2 - 1 GOAL! Great reaction there from Caleb Ekuban (Genoa), who acrobatically contorts his body to score inside the box from a rebound. It’s 2:1.
76' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!

74' Wladimiro Falcone makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) inside the box and he drills a strike goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
74' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Remi Oudin walks off the pitch to be replaced by Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
71' Referee Luca Pairetto has finally had enough of Alberto Gilardino and brandishes a yellow card at him!
70' 1 - 1 An unlucky rebound falls to Mateo Retegui (Genoa) and he scores with a bullet header.
70' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar!
68' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) brings an opponent down and Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. Genoa get a free kick.
66' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Wladimiro Falcone has no trouble gathering it.
66' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.
64' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Nikola Krstovic will be replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
64' A substitution has been made. Nicola Sansone goes off and Lameck Banda (Lecce) comes on.
64' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
62' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

60' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) executes a nice mid-range free kick. His effort only flies inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
57' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
55' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a save.
54' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and it's Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

52' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
51' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
51' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Josep Martinez.

48' OFF THE POST! Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
46' The game is over for Morten Thorsby (Genoa). Stefano Sabelli comes on for the second half.
46' Alberto Gilardino makes a switch. Caleb Ekuban is coming on in place of Djed Spence (Genoa) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The end of the first half.
44' Remi Oudin (Lecce) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

44' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
38' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
37' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
35' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Remi Oudin (Lecce), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
34' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Djed Spence (Genoa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Lecce are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
31' 0 - 1 Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Josep Martinez. 0:1.
30' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
30' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

28' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Pairetto with no other option than to blow for a foul.
25' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar.
24' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
22' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Pairetto who sees an offensive foul.
21' Mattia Bani (Genoa) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
21' The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
20' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

18' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot inside the left post. Josep Martinez anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
17' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
17' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) brings his opponent down. Luca Pairetto has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. Lecce are awarded a penalty kick!
16' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
15' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) tackles a bit over-zealously and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Genoa.
15' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
14' The resulting corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is cleared.
13' A pass into the penalty area from Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.
12' Remi Oudin (Lecce) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.

10' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Wladimiro Falcone makes a great save to stop his effort.
9' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
8' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
7' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pontus Almqvist (Lecce).

6' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
6' Lecce take a short corner kick.
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lecce force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
3' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lecce will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Luca Pairetto will supervise the game today.
